name: Minimal Gallery Page
author: Edgars V

sections.description:
Minimal Gallery Page is a lightweight WordPress plugin that lets you create beautiful, distraction-free image galleries with a clean and intuitive interface.

The plugin adds a dedicated custom post type for galleries, making it easy to manage your images directly from the WordPress admin area. It automatically generates a gallery listing page where all created galleries are displayed, as well as a single gallery page to showcase each gallery’s images in an elegant layout.

Built with a responsive design, Minimal Gallery Page ensures your galleries look great on all devices, from desktops to mobile screens – without unnecessary bloat or complexity.

Features

  • Custom gallery post type for organizing galleries
  • Optimized image sizes for gallery display
  • Customizable URL slug from settings page
  • Easy image management with drag-and-drop interface
  • Responsive and mobile-friendly design
  • Custom templates for archive and single gallery views
  • Automatic permalink flushing when slug changes
  • Theme integration support
  • Translation ready

Usage

  1. Go to Gallery > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Enter a title and description for your gallery
  3. Click “Add images” in the Gallery Images meta box
  4. Select multiple images from your media library
  5. Click “Add to gallery”
  6. Publish your gallery

Navigate to Gallery > Settings to customize the URL slug and access the gallery archive.

Custom Image Sizes

  • minigp_single_gallery – 1230px wide (single gallery view)
  • minigp_list_gallery – 500x500px (gallery archive/listing)

Theme Integration

You can override the default templates by creating custom template files in your theme. The plugin supports both standard WordPress themes and Sage/Blade themes.

For Sage/Blade themes:
your-theme/resources/views/templates/minimal-gallery-page/gallery-single-style-1.blade.php

Available template files:
* gallery-single-style-1.php – Single gallery item template
* template-gallery-1.php – Gallery archive template
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Minimal Gallery Page”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Upload the zip file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin

After Installation

  1. Go to Gallery > Settings to configure your gallery
  2. Customize the URL slug if desired
  3. Start creating galleries by going to Gallery > Add New
sections.faq:
How do I add images to a gallery?

Go to Gallery > Add New, enter a title, then click “Add images” in the Gallery Images meta box on the right side. Select multiple images from your media library and click “Add to gallery”.

Can I change the URL structure?

Yes, go to Gallery > Settings and customize the Gallery Slug field. The default is “minigp-gallery” but you can change it to anything you like, such as “photos” or “portfolio”.

Do I need to manually flush permalinks after changing the slug?

No, the plugin automatically flushes permalink rules when you save a new slug. However, if it doesn’t work, you can manually visit Settings > Permalinks and click “Save Changes”.

How do I view all my galleries?

You can access your galleries in two ways:
1. Frontend: Visit yoursite.com/minigp-gallery/ (or your custom slug)
2. Admin: Go to Gallery > All Items

Can I customize the gallery templates?

Yes, you can override the plugin templates by creating custom template files in your theme. See the Theme Integration section in the Description for details.

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes, the plugin is fully translation ready with text domain ‘minimal-gallery-page’.
